messages:
Maria: Heads-up — we need to schedule the post-incident review for INC-2026-042 (eu-west Hosted API latency spike). Root symptoms were OOM cascades causing retries; impacted a subset of tenants with ~4x latency spikes for ~22m. Can we lock a facilitator and a note-taker?

Incident-bot: auto-summary: INC-2026-042 | started 2026-03-14T09:03Z | mitigated 2026-03-14T09:25Z | svc: hosted-api (eu-west) | symptom: tokenizer/GPU OOM cascades | severity: Sev2 | tags: latency, oncall

Maria: Proposed PIR slot: Tue 2026-03-16 15:00-16:00 UTC — EU/US overlap. Volunteers please. Also need someone to collate pre-read logs/traces and a comms owner for affected customers.

Kai: I can facilitate. I was oncall for the incident and wrote the initial timeline notes. :wave:

Amy: I can take notes and drive the action-triage sheet. I'll create the table in the doc with columns: action, owner, due, severity, status.

Maria: Thanks. Kai — want a runtime co-facilitator so we can deep-dive GPU/kernel stuff?

Kai: Yeah, please. Looping in @Leo for the runtime/kernel section.

Leo: I can co-facilitate the technical deep-dive. I'll prepare the GPU/dmesg excerpts and a short one-page hypothesis. Will add a logs snippet to the pre-read.

Samira: I'll own customer impact and comms. Can someone add the tenant IDs we saw to the doc? I'll draft a comms template for review.

Product-Carlos: I'll help prioritize remediation items by product risk and review the comms. Also need to check SLA credit exposure.

Maria: Link to PIR doc: https://rwinf.docs/pir/INC-2026-042 — please add pre-read materials there. Amy, can you seed actions?

Amy: Seeding actions now. Initial flagged items:
1) Roll back optimizer patch on dedicated pool — owner: @infra-release — due: Thu EOD — severity: high
2) Temporary scale-up of eu-west worker groups — owner: @ops — due: immediate/ASAP — severity: high
3) Add KV/prefix cache health metrics and alerting — owner: @observability — due: next-week — severity: medium

Maria: Agenda suggestion — 20m timeline, 25m technical deep-dive (Leo + Kai), 15m action triage and comms. Fits the 60m slot. Thoughts?

Kai: Sounds good. I'll prepare a 1-slide timeline and 2 slides for the root-cause hypothesis. Amy please flag any timeline gaps in the doc.

Leo: Will paste an example kernel/GPU snippet under the Logs section. Example I'll include: 
```
[pmem] worker=23 OOM-kill pid=4921 (tokenizer) -> retry loop -> backlog increased
GPU0: attempted alloc 512MB -> out of memory
```
I'll also attach `dmesg` lines and GPU allocation traces.

Samira: Adding a Customer Impact table now — tenant IDs, start/end, observed error rates, contact owner. Preliminary: 2 tenants may cross 99.9% SLA window for the 22-minute window — need verification.

Maria: Logistics: Kai please set yourself as facilitator on the calendar invite. Amy will be the note-taker and action tracker. Leo gets a presenter slot for runtime deep-dive. Samira & Product-Carlos own comms approval.

Amy: Confirmed I'll be notes + publish pre-read by Mon EOD with initial timeline and action seeds. I'll create the action-triage table in the doc.

Kai: I'll claim facilitation on the invite and record the session for folks who can't make it.

Leo: Planning to add a short replay GIF of the mitigation steps (if we can extract it) and the relevant logs.

Maria: Pre-read checklist before Tue:
- Pre-read uploaded: Mon EOD (Amy + Leo + Samira)
- Action-triage table seeded and owners assigned (Amy)
- Calendar invite updated with Zoom + doc link (Maria will confirm)

Samira: Drafted the comms template and added it under "Customer Impact -> Communications". Please review; Product-Carlos and Maria please sign off before we send.

Product-Carlos: I'll review the comms draft after Samira posts and give approval/edits.

Incident-bot: Reminder: PIR pre-read due 2026-03-15T23:59Z (owner: Amy). Calendar reminder scheduled 1h before meeting.

Maria: Great work. Any other attendees want to join, add your name to the doc. Kai please run the session and capture decisions + owners in the live doc.

Kai: Will do. See you Tue. :thumbsup:
